tools.name: brandboom_list_showrooms
tools.description: List the showrooms this account can access, with their showroom ids. Other tools need a showroom id. Brandboom API: GET /v3/showrooms/search.

tools.name: brandboom_list_price_tiers
tools.description: List price tiers for the brands this account can access. Products need a price tier id. Brandboom API: GET /v3/priceTiers/search.

tools.name: brandboom_search_products
tools.description: Search products with their descriptions, prices and SKUs, in one showroom and one price tier. Brandboom API: GET /v3/products/search.

tools.name: brandboom_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by id, keyword, order date, ship date or status. Brandboom API: GET /v3/orders/search.

tools.name: brandboom_get_order_pdf
tools.description: Create the PDF of one order and return a temporary download link. The file is deleted 24 hours after it is made. Brandboom API: GET /v3/orders/pdf.

tools.name: brandboom_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by id, keyword, customer code, type (billing or shipping) or last change date. Brandboom API: GET /v3/customers/search.

tools.name: brandboom_search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices in one or more showrooms, by id, order, keyword or date. Brandboom API: GET /v3/invoices/search.

tools.name: brandboom_search_shipments
tools.description: Find shipments by shipment ids or by invoice id, optionally filtered by status. Give shipmentIDs or invoiceID. Brandboom API: GET /v3/shipments/search.
